pages.d: Thamudic and Ancient North Arabian inscription scanner research: image segmentation, glyph evidence, Unicode, transliteration and scholarly verification.
pages.x: Thamudic / Ancient North Arabian Scanner Research portal for photographing, segmenting, cataloguing and studying Ancient North Arabian inscriptions, including material historically grouped as Thamudic. Architecture Image → normalization → segmentation → glyph candidates → evidence record → optional classifier → scholarly verification → transliteration/translation The baseline implementation is maintained in amerhwitat/nlp as thamudic_scanner.py . It does not require Tesseract or camel_tools. Scholarly sources OCIANA — Thamudic overview Unicode — Old North Arabian Unicode Core Specification Writing Systems Technical Resources Recent external demo references Bubble Thamudic Scan Thamudic Translator UI Historical Artifacts Database UI These are external references; their source code is not assumed to be open-source.
